 versus

 Through: Ms. Priyanka Dalal, App for t

with Si Kapil Kr., P.S. Cyber
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Jain
ORDER % 04.02.2026 CRL.M.A. 3795/2026 (exemption) Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
1. Applicant seeks bail in FIR No. 0038/2024 dated 07.06.2024 under Sections 170/420/120B IPC at P.S. Cyber Police Station Central.
2. It is submitted that, except for certain alleged incriminating material like PAN Card, SIM Cards and some cheque books etc., there is no other recovery from the accused.

3. According to the learned counsel for petitioner, the premises in question was on rent with some other person known as Mohit and the recovery cannot be fastened upon him in a mechanical manner.
4.
Learned APP for the State, however, submits that there is one more case against the applicant of similar kind, and she seeks time to place on record a detailed status report.

5. List on 13.02.2026.
MANOJ JAIN, J FEBRUARY 4, 2026/ss/pb
